verdict.rationale: Phoenix's self-hosting docs state that self-hosted data stays entirely within your infrastructure, that nothing is sent to Arize, and that deployments can be fully air-gapped. That speaks directly to avoiding vendor-side tracking. However, the pack documents no explicit telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out switch, and nothing covers telemetry in the SDK, CLI or hosted offerings. missing for 10: documented telemetry opt-out setting (env var/config flag), coverage of client SDK/CLI analytics, independent or hands-on corroboration that no usage data is collected.
